svg.text: How one run works on update-deprecated-e52
1 launch → up to 8 phases → about 37,000 steps per phase → every step: look, decide, limit, move, measure
Where this run sits in the whole method

happens once, on the Windows lab machine
start distance) and the step cap
Trainer: up to 8 phases. Each phase is one call of Evaluator.run_evaluation(phase, payload).
Phase 1's target is whatever is in dataV22.py. Phases 2 to 8 are fixed in evaluator.py.
Each arrow is the payload: the pose a phase ends in is the pose the next one starts from.
inside one phase, repeated about 36,800 times for Neutral → N
Work out which way to move.
Jaw: a trial rotation in Maya,
Lips: a small cap that eases in.
jaw every step, the others only
env.step: about 47 ms of the 52 ms a step takes
Save the moves, logs and plots.
Hand the end pose to the next phase.
Timings are from the 11/19 full run,
before the lip read was skipped
(step 4 used to read the lips every step).
What one phase looks like in time
Neutral → N, 11/19 full run: 36,782 steps, 33.6 minutes
at the target, sitting still and waiting for the jaw: about 35,800 steps
full speed: the anatomical limit on how fast a jaw can rotate
The lips need about 950 steps. The jaw's speed limit decides the other 35,800, which is 96% of the run time.
